title: Repair an incremental workspace search index
goal: Repair a persistent workspace search index across scanner.py, chunker.py, storage.py, index.py, and search.py. Scan nested .md and .txt files in deterministic path order, excluding hidden paths, symlinks, unsupported extensions, and invalid UTF-8. Hash original file bytes. Chunk text by max_lines while preserving 1-based inclusive source line numbers, retaining a final partial chunk and omitting blank-only groups. A sync adds new files, replaces changed files and their old chunks, removes deleted files, preserves unchanged files, reports accurate counts, and persists changes across reopened stores. Search is case-insensitive, requires every query term as a whole word within one chunk, ranks by total term frequency then path and start line, and supports path_prefix and limit. Preserve the public functions and classes used by the tests. The acceptance suite is fixed; edit only the listed implementation files.
